intro: A structured, 9-stage process to ensure your engine is rebuilt with the right parts, to the correct specification, and tested before it gets back on the road.

stages.title: Recovery or Booked Workshop Arrival
stages.text: We record the vehicle, symptoms and running status, review existing reports and agree how it will arrive. Optional transport is separately quoted rather than assumed to be included.

stages.title: Engine Identification and Diagnosis
stages.text: The fitted engine and relevant symptoms determine the checks. Appropriate mechanical evidence is considered alongside diagnostic information before the scope of removal or dismantling is agreed.

stages.title: Engine Removal Where Required
stages.text: Access, drivetrain and connected equipment are considered for the actual vehicle. A compact car, SUV and van may have different installation requirements even when the family name is familiar.

stages.title: Strip-down, Cleaning and Inspection
stages.text: The engine is dismantled sufficiently to establish the damage and overhaul scope. Cleaning and inspection help distinguish reusable components from worn, damaged or contaminated parts.

stages.title: Measurement and Machining Decisions
stages.text: Relevant bores, journals and head components are assessed against the applicable repair requirements. Machining is specified where suitable; major structural damage can require a revised quotation or a different route.

stages.title: Parts Selection and Engine Assembly
stages.text: The agreed internal, timing and sealing components are matched to the engine derivative. Assembly addresses the identified cause and condition, with ancillary work separately specified where needed.

stages.title: Refitting and Controlled First Start
stages.text: After refitting, appropriate fluid, connection and initial-running checks follow the repair scope. Coding or adaptation is carried out where the actual installation requires it, rather than promised universally.

stages.title: Running Checks and Road Test
stages.text: Checks consider the original symptom and operation after the repair. A road test is performed where safe and appropriate; a dyno power run is not assumed to be included in every rebuild.

stages.title: Collection, Handover and Follow-up
stages.text: We explain the completed work, maintenance and warranty conditions. The required chargeable running-in service is arranged in line with the terms, and any later concern should be reported promptly.

closingBar.title: A Clear, Step-by-Step Rebuild Process
closingBar.text: From diagnosis to handover, every stage is planned, checked and carried out to the right specification for your engine and vehicle.
